source_text: eges fullíc; adj. Full of fear, fearful, awful; terr&i-short;b&i-short;lis :-- Hú eges-fullíc he is in geþeahtingum ofer monna bearn Quam terr&i-short;b&i-short;lis est in cons&i-short;liis s&u-short;per f&i-short;lios hom&i-short;num, Bd. 4, 25; S. 601, 36.
